sloka: भवान् स्निग्धः सुहृन् मह्यम् गुरुः च परमो महान् ।वोढव्यो भवता च एव भारो यज्ञस्य च उद्यतः ॥१-१३-४॥
transliteration: bhavān snigdhaḥ suhṛn mahyam guruḥ ca paramo mahān ।voḍhavyo bhavatā ca eva bhāro yajñasya ca udyataḥ ॥1-13-4॥

translations.english: You are an affectionate friend and most reverential spiritual guide to me. The burden of performing the sacrifice which has since commenced shall be borne by you".
translations.hindi: यह सुन महाराज दशरथ ने मंत्रिश्रवर सुमन्त से कहा कि, वेदपाठ करने वाले ऋत्विजों को तुरन्त बुलवा इए
